artifact_types.teacher_plan: Use professional pedagogical language, explicit rationale and editable structure.
artifact_types.family_report: Use clear nontechnical language, concrete examples and supportive next steps; avoid comparisons with peers.
artifact_types.internal_report: May include coverage, frequency and operational indicators with warnings that they are not final pedagogical levels.
artifact_types.learning_material: Align task to child agency, age and purpose; avoid excessive textual load for children.

provenance_policy: Backend should retain knowledge_unit_ids/source_refs used to produce every artifact, even if teacher-facing document hides citations.
